verdict.rationale: React's own docs say it can start streaming HTML on the server while data is still being fetched, progressively filling in content before any JavaScript loads (react-docs-6). It renders on the server with Node (react-gh-2), and hydrateRoot attaches interactivity to HTML generated by react-dom/server (react-docs-9), which together cover streaming SSR followed by hydration. Missing for 10: reference docs for the specific streaming server API, evidence on selective or progressive hydration for faster time-to-interactive, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on how much of this works without a recommended framework (react-docs-4, react-docs-7).
